text:
Ava: Quick thread — prepping the EBR for Meridian (Thu 10am PT). Need a short 'onboarding health' deep-dive slide + 3 exec asks. I'm putting together risks and owners. Can folks confirm owners and slide bullets? Deck: https://redwood.app/slides/meridian-ebr-draft

Liam: I can own the onboarding velocity slide. Will include: seats activated, time-to-first-call, feature adoption (chat vs embeddings). Question — do we want to surface session-level latency impact or keep perf on a separate slide? cc @Tom

Tom: Include a one-line perf note on the onboarding slide (95p latency spike last Friday). I'll attach the SLO graph and the brief mitigation note — we routed to a smaller model fallback.

Maya: For exec asks: renewal risk is flagged (usage plateau among power users). Proposed asks: 1) 6-week dedicated capacity pilot, 2) 1x Solutions Eng for enablement, 3) clearly defined success metrics for M1–M3. Does that map to what sales needs?

Keren: Sales will back the pilot ask if we include a short ROI bullet (expected uplift vs cost delta). I'll draft the pricing/ROI line and a recommended pilot scope.

Ava: Action list — please confirm owners by EOD. I'll consolidate. Proposed slide bullets: 1) current health snapshot (metrics + adoption highlights), 2) key risks & short mitigations, 3) three clear asks (pilot, SE, SLO commitments).

Liam: Here is a quick action table I can start with:

```
Owner | Item | Due
Liam  | Onboarding metrics slide + screenshots | Wed 3pm PT
Tom   | SLO perf graph + mitigation note     | Wed 2pm PT
Keren | ROI bullet + pilot pricing            | Wed 5pm PT
Maya  | Exec asks wording + success criteria  | Wed 5pm PT
Ava   | Final deck + runbook                  | Thu 8am PT
```

Maya: :thumbsup: LGTM. One more ask — capture a verbatim customer feedback snippet about API key rotation friction and surface as a moderate risk.

Tom: Will add a one-liner on key rotation impact (security review scheduled this week).

Ava: Thanks. Quick sync — short dry-run Tue 9am PT? Can everyone make it for a 20–30m run-through?

Keren: I can make Tue 9am PT.

Liam: Blocked — team offsite Tue. Can we move to Wed 9am PT instead?

Maya: Wed works for me.

Ava: Ok Wed 9am PT it is — I'll send a calendar invite and a slide stub to review. Thanks everyone :pray:

calendar-bot: Event created: "Meridian EBR dry-run" Wed 9:00–9:30am PT — attendees: Ava, Maya, Keren, Tom, Liam

Ava: I'll consolidate the deck by Wed morning and ping here when it's ready for final review.
